name: Shared Notes
description: A tiny persistent notes list that can be used in the dashboard and, with separate approval, by Pi.

skills.name: shared-notes-overview
skills.description: Explains how Shared Notes works and how its separate PI access grants affect available actions.

skills.name: shared-notes-review
skills.description: Reviews notes saved in Shared Notes when PI read access is granted.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.label: List notes
tools.description: List the notes currently saved in the Shared Notes plugin.

tools.name: add_note
tools.label: Add a note
tools.description: Add a short note to the Shared Notes plugin.

text.description: The note text, up to 240 characters.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.label: Delete a note
tools.description: Delete one Shared Notes item by its ID.

id.description: The exact note ID returned by List notes.
